# Active Repository Packet

- **Packet:** `architecture-step-22-runtime-fanin-gate-value-hardening` — Harden Step 22 runtime fan-in and permanent-gate value decisions
- **Status:** `active`
- **Tracking:** #194, #126
- **Baseline:** `main` / `fa55e50f356b9a54712843038f763741898534b8`

## Objective

Strengthen the normative architecture and delivery plans before Repository Step 15 begins so Repository Step 22 cannot close on non-growth alone: it must produce a mechanical decision for every owner-specific direct dependency of crm-application-runtime and a value/cost review of every permanent gate, while preserving the existing Step 15–25 order and all product-readiness boundaries.

## Deliverables

- `add ADR-032 as the binding decision for Step 22 runtime fan-in and permanent-gate value review`
- `require Step 22 to classify every internal direct dependency of crm-application-runtime and either remove every safely removable owner-specific dependency or prove each retained dependency is an unavoidable stable process-composition boundary`
- `make mere non-growth insufficient and require ordinary existing-owner capability changes plus the Step 23 and Step 24 expert-domain waves to avoid crm-application-runtime manifest and owner-specific source edits`
- `require a complete permanent-gate ledger covering concrete prevented failure mode, observed defect evidence or preventive rationale, overlap and duplication, execution cost, owner, retain/simplify/merge/remove decision and retirement condition`
- `require every new permanent gate to declare the same value, cost, overlap, ownership and retirement fields before acceptance`
- `synchronize the architecture plan, roadmap, Phase 8 plan, delivery governance and project status without starting Repository Step 15 or changing product readiness`
- `regenerate docs/ACTIVE_PACKET.md and add permanent documentation/navigation guards for the hardened Step 22 criteria`

## Acceptance

- all live architecture and delivery plans describe Step 22 as architecture remeasurement plus a crm-application-runtime fan-in decision and permanent-gate value review
- Step 22 cannot pass through budget non-growth alone and leaves no crm-application-runtime internal direct dependency unclassified as removed, retained platform-generic or retained unavoidable stable process-composition
- every retained owner-specific crm-application-runtime dependency has evidence that removing it would weaken a real process, trust, security or ownership boundary and that ordinary owner changes do not modify the runtime manifest or owner-specific runtime composition
- the permanent-gate review records concrete failure mode, defect evidence or preventive rationale, duplication, execution cost, owner, disposition and retirement condition for every permanent workflow and gate
- duplicate or low-value gates are simplified, merged or removed unless an independent failure mode and cost justification is proven
- Repository Steps 15–21 and 23–25 retain their existing order; Repository Step 15 remains next and not started
- Phase 8A and Customer Privacy remain incomplete, architecture 10/10 remains unclaimed and product-complete expert modules remain zero
- the exact planning pull-request head passes every applicable permanent workflow on one unchanged meaningful user-authored SHA
